baby.label: Baby / Infant (0-12 months)
baby.description: Non-walking or early crawling infants, entirely reliant on caregiver supervision, with natural mouthing behaviors and zero hazard recognition.

reach_mobility_characteristics.mobility: Crawling, rolling, non-walking or early cruising along low furniture edges
reach_mobility_characteristics.mouthing_behaviour: Universal exploratory mouthing of any accessible object
reach_mobility_characteristics.physical_resilience: Extremely fragile skull, bones, and skin; acute drowning risk in shallow water

category_vulnerabilities.H01: Non-walking but crawling; can slip if carried or if learning to stand on wet tiles.
category_vulnerabilities.H02: Floor clutter and low cables obstruct crawling path and can cause facial impact.
category_vulnerabilities.H03: Pulls on hanging cords, mouths plugged-in cables, or reaches low wall outlets.
category_vulnerabilities.H04: Cannot escape radiant heat; space heaters near floor or dropped hot liquids cause severe scalds.
category_vulnerabilities.H05: Crawls directly onto fallen glass or reaches blades on low ledges; delicate skin cuts deeply.
category_vulnerabilities.H06: Rolls off beds, changing tables, and crawls toward unprotected stair drops.
category_vulnerabilities.H07: Pulls on low tablecloths, cords, or cabinet handles causing heavy items to topple downward.
category_vulnerabilities.H08: Licks accessible bottles or swallows floor-level cleaning products; acute poisoning.
category_vulnerabilities.H09: Universal mouthing of small items under 3 cm (coins, button batteries, beads) poses airway obstruction.
category_vulnerabilities.H10: Can drown silently in as little as 5 cm of standing water in an open bucket, tub, or basin.
category_vulnerabilities.H11: Entanglement in blind cords, crib ribbon loops, or suffocating thin plastic bags.
category_vulnerabilities.H12: Vulnerable to falling plaster debris and respiratory distress from indoor mould spores.
category_vulnerabilities.H13: Caregivers carrying an infant in dark hallways or unlit stairs face trip hazards.
category_vulnerabilities.H14: Crawling toward open gates or driveways; completely defenseless against vehicles.
category_vulnerabilities.H15: General observable physical anomaly requiring caregiver evaluation.

child.label: Child (1-12 years)
child.description: Active, curious, highly mobile toddlers and young children with limited impulse control and hazard foresight.

reach_mobility_characteristics.mobility: Running, jumping, climbing furniture, fast and unpredictable movement
reach_mobility_characteristics.hazard_recognition: Minimal to partial; high curiosity with poor risk anticipation
reach_mobility_characteristics.mouthing_behaviour: Frequent in toddlers (under 3 years); occasional in older children
reach_mobility_characteristics.physical_resilience: Developing musculoskeletal system; high vulnerability to falls and burns

category_vulnerabilities.H01: Running on wet or slick floors leads to sudden high-velocity falls.
category_vulnerabilities.H02: Running through walkways without looking down leads to tripping over toys or cords.
category_vulnerabilities.H03: Inserts keys or toys into outlets; pulls hanging appliance cables off counters.
category_vulnerabilities.H04: Reaches for pan handles on stoves, touches hot irons, or experiments with matches.
category_vulnerabilities.H05: Grabs unsheathed knives from counters or steps barefoot on broken glass.
category_vulnerabilities.H06: Climbs window sills, balcony railings, or playground heights without recognizing drop danger.
category_vulnerabilities.H07: Climbs open dresser drawers like stairs, toppling unanchored bookcases and heavy TVs.
category_vulnerabilities.H08: Consumes brightly colored cleaning liquids or sweet-tasting pills mistaking them for juice or candy.
category_vulnerabilities.H09: Puts small toy parts, button batteries, coins, or deflated balloons into mouth.
category_vulnerabilities.H10: Falls into open pools, sumps, or buckets without swimming or self-rescue capability.
category_vulnerabilities.H11: Wraps window blind cords or ropes around neck during imaginative play.
category_vulnerabilities.H12: Leans against wobbly railings or plays beneath crumbling plaster/masonry.
category_vulnerabilities.H13: Runs through dim rooms or unlit stairs and collides with unseen obstacles.
category_vulnerabilities.H14: Darts impulsively into roads or driveways after toys without checking for moving vehicles.
category_vulnerabilities.H15: Unusual physical hazard demanding prompt adult supervision.

adult.label: Adult
adult.description: Standard baseline adult with full mobility, height, reach, hazard awareness, and defensive reactions.

reach_mobility_characteristics.mobility: Full agility, mature defensive reflexes, steady gait
reach_mobility_characteristics.physical_resilience: Standard adult bone density and soft tissue resilience

category_vulnerabilities.H01: Slick surfaces can cause unexpected slips, ankle sprains, or muscle strains.
category_vulnerabilities.H02: Trailing cords and clutter can cause tripping when carrying heavy loads or walking in a hurry.
category_vulnerabilities.H03: Exposed wiring or water contact risks electric shock and burn injuries.
category_vulnerabilities.H04: Hot cookware, grease fires, or heating appliances require active defensive handling.
category_vulnerabilities.H05: Exposed knife blades or broken glass cause lacerations during manual handling.
category_vulnerabilities.H06: Unguarded drops or unstable ladders cause severe occupational or domestic fall trauma.
category_vulnerabilities.H07: Heavy falling objects or tipping shelving units cause impact contusions or fractures.
category_vulnerabilities.H08: Corrosive cleaners or toxic fumes cause chemical burns or respiratory irritation.
category_vulnerabilities.H09: Extremely low accidental choking risk for small non-food household objects.
category_vulnerabilities.H10: Accidental drowning in domestic buckets or basins is exceptionally rare.
category_vulnerabilities.H11: Strangulation or entrapment from cords and plastic bags is virtually non-existent.
category_vulnerabilities.H12: Falling masonry or cracked floors cause impact or ankle twisting injuries.
category_vulnerabilities.H13: Walking through dark passages increases collision and stumble likelihood.
category_vulnerabilities.H14: Uneven terrain, potholes, and road traffic require active attentiveness.
category_vulnerabilities.H15: General observable physical hazard requiring standard evaluation.

elderly.label: Elderly Relative / Senior Adult
elderly.description: Older adults with reduced balance, slower reflexes, fragile bone density, and diminished sensory acuity.

reach_mobility_characteristics.mobility: Shuffling gait, reduced step clearance, slower reaction time, impaired balance
reach_mobility_characteristics.hazard_recognition: High awareness, but physically limited in fast defensive reactions
reach_mobility_characteristics.physical_resilience: High bone fragility (osteoporosis); severe hip/pelvic fracture risk from low falls

category_vulnerabilities.H01: Slipping on wet floors or slick tiles causes severe hip/pelvic fractures and loss of mobility.
category_vulnerabilities.H02: Shuffling gait catches on trailing cords, curled rug edges, or floor clutter causing hard falls.
category_vulnerabilities.H03: Diminished eyesight makes damaged cords hard to spot; bending to reach outlets risks dizziness.
category_vulnerabilities.H04: Reduced heat sensitivity, loose clothing catching burners, or forgetting active heat sources.
category_vulnerabilities.H05: Hand tremors or reduced grip strength can cause dropped knives; fragile skin tears easily.
category_vulnerabilities.H06: Loss of balance on stairs without handrails results in catastrophic fall trauma.
category_vulnerabilities.H07: Leaning on wobbly furniture or shelving units for balance support can topple the furniture.
category_vulnerabilities.H08: Visual impairment can lead to misreading medication labels or mistaking cleaning fluids.
category_vulnerabilities.H09: May experience swallowing difficulties (dysphagia) with large dry pills or food, not toy choking.
category_vulnerabilities.H10: Slipping inside a bathtub with inability to stand up or summon immediate assistance.
category_vulnerabilities.H11: Low strangulation relevance; occasional trip or entanglement risk from cord bundles.
category_vulnerabilities.H12: Broken floorboards, uneven steps, or crumbling masonry cause sudden balance loss.
category_vulnerabilities.H13: Slow dark adaptation and reduced contrast vision make unlit stairs and dark hallways hazardous.
category_vulnerabilities.H14: Slower walking pace, difficulty judging approaching vehicle speeds, and tripping on broken kerbs.
category_vulnerabilities.H15: Unusual physical hazard demanding increased caution and mobility support.
